html:
/* Item card (potions, food, talismans, tokens, crates ...). Same look as the Mount and Glider cards. Position comes inline from Module:Consumable. */
.aa-item {
  display: flow-root;
  position: relative;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 300px;
  max-width: 100%;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(24, 28, 38, 0.97), rgba(10, 12, 18, 0.97));
  border: 1px solid #5a5040;
  border-radius: 3px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #000, 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  margin: 0 0 0.5em 0;
  color: #e8e4d8;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  text-align: left;
}
.aa-item-head {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.aa-item-icon {
  line-height: 0;
}
.aa-item-title {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  line-height: 1.3;
}
.aa-item-cat {
  color: #e8e4d8;
}
.aa-item-grade {
  font-size: 13px;
}
.aa-item-name {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: bold;
}
.aa-item-sep {
  height: 1px;
  margin: 6px 0;
  background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #6a5d48, transparent);
}
.aa-item-line {
  color: #e8e4d8;
}
.aa-item-desc {
  margin-top: 4px;
  color: #e8e4d8;
}
/* a blank line in the description */
.aa-item-gap {
  margin-top: 0.7em;
}
.aa-item-label {
  margin-top: 10px;
  color: #8a8478;
}
.aa-item-green {
  color: #9acd32;
}

/* A card floated to the right opens skill boxes (pets) towards the left, so they stay on the screen */
.aa-item-right .aa-mskill-tip {
  left: auto;
  right: 0;
}

/* Phones: a floated card gets its own line instead of squeezing the text */
@media (max-width: 500px) {
  .aa-item-float {
    float: none !important;
    clear: both !important;
    margin: 0 0 0.5em 0 !important;
  }
  /* skill hover boxes (pets) become a panel at the bottom of the screen (tap a skill to open) */
  .aa-item .aa-mskill-tip {
    position: fixed;
    left: 0.5em;
    right: 0.5em;
    top: auto;
    bottom: 0.5em;
    width: auto;
    max-height: 60vh;
    overflow-y: auto;
    margin-top: 0;
  }
}

/* "Obtained from": crafts and quests that give the item, and the lines typed in by editors */
.aa-src {
  font-size: 13px;
}
.aa-src-title {
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  color: #8a8478;
  font-size: 12px;
}
.aa-src-group {
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.aa-src-group:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}
.aa-src-head {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: baseline;
  color: #8a8478;
  font-size: 12px;
}
.aa-src-name {
  color: #e8e4d8;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}
.aa-src-line {
  position: relative;
  padding-left: 12px;
  color: #c9c3b4;
}
.aa-src-line::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 2px;
  top: 0.6em;
  width: 4px;
  height: 4px;
  background: #6a5d48;
  transform: rotate(45deg);
}
/* the colours of the links: crafts in gold, quests in light blue (change here) */
.aa-src-craft a,
.aa-src-craft a:visited {
  color: #F8D870;
}
.aa-src-quest a,
.aa-src-quest a:visited {
  color: #8ec5ff;
}
/* "and N more": the whole list opens beside the card, as tall as the card (scrolls when it is longer), while the pointer rests on it.
   It is placed against the card itself (.aa-item is position: relative), not against the line, so it follows the side of the card. */
.aa-src-more {
  margin-left: -12px;    /* the line reaches the left edge of the card, so the pointer can move from the line onto the list */
  padding-left: 24px;
  padding-right: 0;
  color: #8a8478;
  font-style: italic;
  cursor: default;
}
.aa-src-morelabel::after {
  content: " \203A";
}
.aa-src-all {
  display: none;
  position: absolute;
  top: -1px;
  bottom: -1px;
  right: 100%;   /* on the left side of the card: the card itself usually sits far to the right, the list stays on the screen */
  z-index: 201;
  width: 277px;
  padding-right: 7px;   /* no gap, so the list stays open while the pointer moves onto it */
  box-sizing: border-box;
  font-style: normal;
}
.aa-src-more:hover .aa-src-all {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: flex-end;   /* a short list sits at the bottom of the card, level with its lower edge */
}
.aa-src-box {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  flex: 0 1 auto;
  min-height: 0;
  max-height: 100%;   /* never taller than the card; longer lists scroll */
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  background: #23262d;
  border: 1px solid #3a3d45;
  border-radius: 3px;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
}
.aa-src-boxhead {
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  color: #e8e4d8;
  font-weight: 600;
}
/* Phones: no room beside the card, the list opens below the line */
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .aa-src-all {
    top: 100%;
    bottom: auto;
    left: 0;
    right: auto;
    padding: 4px 0 0;
    width: 100%;
  }
  .aa-src-box {
    max-height: 280px;
  }
  .aa-src-more {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0 0 0 12px;
  }
}
